junior.en: Junior high school will bring many new subjects.

graduate.en: After we graduate, we'll go to different junior high schools.
graduate.cn: 毕业后我们会去不同的初中。

primary.en: Six years of primary school taught me many things.
primary.cn: 六年小学教会我很多事。

memory.en: I'll keep the wonderful memories of primary school forever.
memory.cn: 我会永远珍藏小学的美好回忆。

future.en: I look forward to the future with hope and courage.
future.cn: 我带着希望和勇气期待未来。

challenge.en: Every challenge is a chance to grow stronger.
challenge.cn: 每个挑战都是变强的机会。

ready.en: We are all ready for the new chapter ahead.
ready.cn: 我们都为接下来的新篇章准备好了。

confident.en: Walk into junior high with a confident smile.
confident.cn: 带着自信的微笑走进初中。
